session-terminals.terminalsRunOnThisSess: Terminals run on this session's Worker in its primary workspace. Agent Stop preserves them. Archive closes their owned processes.
session-terminals.waitingForAServerThatS: Waiting for a server that supports session terminals.
session-terminals.textOutputViewUseTermi: Text output view. Use terminal byte input for interactive controls; full-screen application display is not emulated here.
session-terminals.unsentDiscarded: Unsent terminal input was discarded. Accepted operations retain their original recovery.
session-terminals.outputGap: Terminal output is incomplete. The screen was reset before retained output; missing bytes cannot recover a complete application screen.
session-terminals.inputOverflow: Input was not queued: the unsent 64 KiB limit would be exceeded. Wait before pasting again.
session-terminals.rendererUnavailable: Terminal display is unavailable. Reattach the original terminal or close it explicitly.
session-terminals.uncertainInput: Delivery is uncertain. Explicitly retry only the original terminal operation.
session-terminals.emptyInventory: No session terminals. Create one explicitly with +.
